assessment: Root evaluator semantic review against frozen extended-rubric; not keyword scoring or engine tests.

basis: Different surfaces receive distinct mechanisms, with planar reflection conditional on GPU cost and SSR/static captures rejected for unseen moving actors.
Sealed-room interior mapping is bounded by non-entry/collision assumptions; distant billboard use preserves near-sign silhouettes.
Normal textures remain lighting detail; rendered silhouette and authoritative collision stay separate.
Four applicable entries were inspected; camera-angle, offscreen, clipping and pass-cost experiments are proposed, not executed.
Representation, seeded shape, meshing and traversability are separated; heightfield-only overhangs are rejected.
Hermite inputs and QEF prerequisites are explicit, including deriving/validating intersections and gradients.
Minimum-radius collision-space reachability is validated separately, with failed-seed handling and edit-policy uncertainty exposed.
Shared sample ownership/versioned render-collision activation and border/stale-job tests are proposed. No claim seed alone restores edits.
Global weighted routes are separated from local jams; exit fields, invalidation and authoritative collisions are considered rather than blanket faster A*.
Visibility requires normalized angle inputs plus occlusion; path results cannot prove line of sight.
Persistent lock-on/loss rules and manual switching are retained.
Exact plugin search is empty, a broadened query yields generic/noisy candidates, and the response rejects those as vendor API proof while continuing independent design.
Competitive smoke uses common authoritative occupancy/visibility, separately from client lighting/reconstruction quality.
Buoyancy must query the same wave/time/space, with horizontal displacement inversion caveat; full fluid replacement is rejected for limited wave needs.
Premultiplied versus straight-alpha mismatch is used as supplied evidence; color-space and API settings remain conditional.
Distinct minimal changes and target-quality/depth/buoyancy/blend checks replace an unearned universal solver/performance promise.
Per-frame lerp is replaced by a bounded time-consistent damping model, with stationary-target guarantee distinguished from moving-target behavior.
Finite two-second transition owns elapsed time and inverts Bezier x or validates its mapping, rather than confusing damping with duration.
Real capsule/sweep constraints and supported body sizes require geometry/contact checks, not curve changes.
Comfort options preserve movement/aim; document/math checks are explicitly distinct from absent engine/play evaluation.
Attenuation, door filtering/obstruction and room response are separate, with listener authority and warning recognition preserved.
Stems share playback position while section/bridge changes use authored musical boundaries.
Rapid edges are coalesced/cancelled under explicit scheduling, with no global cue restart.
Unknown middleware support remains conditional; listening offsets, reversals, doors, room transitions and stalls are proposed.
Rating uncertainty and search constraints are separate; aggregate 50% cannot establish calibration or a per-match guarantee.
Hidden ranked damage/loot manipulation is rejected under the supplied promise, while bounded PvE pacing remains conditional.
Pity is a different conditional probability process, with advertised fixed odds and tail/maximum claims checked without invented data.
Recoverable-health expiry/pool and action eligibility remain authored; deliberate damage policies and economy interactions are proposed tests.
Contact uses support, shoe offset, knee/reach, gait and pelvis limits while retaining combat capsule and releasing destroyed supports.
Guide/interpolation/shadow costs and platform support are distinct; offscreen updates are not indiscriminately disabled.
Gameplay-support debris retains collision/state; cosmetic debris can have limited activation/sleep/lifetime instead of every piece simulating.
Exact and broader lookup do not establish vendor callback ABI/thread/lifetime guarantees; only the dependent integration is deferred. Filename-only sibling discovery exposed no case content.
Palette-file, decoded and GPU budgets remain distinct; scaling/filter choices are checked at actual display sizes.
Single affine perspective is rejected; scanline changes/projection and fixed-point choices are bounded by non-cycle-exact scope.
Controller payload transport is not automatic executable input; parser bounds/overflow/lifetime failure mechanisms are explicit.
Exact/variant private-format queries do not reveal a grammar; required version/endian/length/offset limits and examples are requested rather than fabricated. Visual analysis continues.
Element/material transitions are a chosen conceptual model, not universal chemistry or verified private Nintendo scheduling.
Simultaneous effects use an authored directed-rule/precedence/commit contract; coefficients, cycles and authority remain explicit.
Attack/hurt/blocking volumes and per-swing target identities are distinct from separately timed sustained damage.
VFX does not establish damage; state/attack histories, replication and save/load consistency require proposed checks, not a runtime pass.

N03.basis: Same frozen criteria pass: global/local/perception/lock-on decisions remain separate; exact and variant plugin queries are empty, and generic evidence is not a vendor guarantee. Weighted successor wording remained coarse, motivating a separately recorded supplemental graph check rather than changing this rubric.

N04.basis: Same frozen criteria pass: smoke authority/rendering, matched wave queries and premultiplied composition have distinct actions and pending target tests; a universal fluid replacement is rejected.

N09.basis: Same frozen criteria pass: storage/runtime/projection and input-execution claims remain bounded; exact private-format lookup is empty and only decoder commitment is deferred.

supplemental_finding.reason: Decreasing cost does not specify adding the outgoing edge cost or zero-cost progress; a supplemental counterexample suite was added after the frozen run. Original rubric and passing decisions are retained.

followup.basis: Fresh performer inspected corrected PATH, rejected min-T neighbor selection, preserved original directed costs and required acyclic zero-cost progress. Evaluator recomputed all three variants independently. This does not retroactively change the original frozen criteria.
